name: WdFrenchSpeller
description: Indicates which version of French to use when using the French language spelling checker dictionaries.

constants.name: wdFrenchBoth
constants.description: Use both Post Reform and Pre-Reform French dictionaries when checking French language spelling.

constants.name: wdFrenchPreReform
constants.description: Use only the Pre-Reform French dictionary when checking French language spelling.

constants.name: wdFrenchPostReform
constants.description: Use only the Post Reform French dictionary when checking French language spelling.
